message.content:
Yes—you can file a noise complaint in Atlanta. Noise complaints are handled by the **City of Atlanta Police Department** (or the City’s 311 system), not by a city council office. ### How to file a complaint | Method | What to do | Contact | |--------|------------|---------| | **Online** | • Visit the City of Atlanta’s official website:
• Click “311” or “Contact Us.”
• Select “Noise Complaint” (or “Public Safety”) and fill out the form. | Online portal | | **Phone** | • Call the Atlanta Police Department’s 311 line: **(404) 656‑4000**.
• Tell the dispatcher you want to file a noise complaint. | 311 | | **In‑person** | • Go to the nearest police station or the City Hall’s public service desk.
• Request a noise complaint form and submit it. | City Hall or police station | ### What information you’ll need - **Date & time** of the disturbance - **Location** (address or intersection) - **Description** of the noise (e.g., loud music, barking dogs, construction) - **Name & contact info** (optional but helpful) ### After you file - The police will investigate and may issue a warning or citation. - If the issue persists, you can follow up by calling 311 or visiting the police station. ### Quick links - **City of Atlanta 311 portal**: - **Atlanta Police Department**: - **Phone**: (404) 656‑4000 Feel free to let me know if you’d like help navigating the online form or if you have any other questions!
